desc: he Elevation FDX was built for hunters who demand a lightweight rifle without compromising capability, adaptability, or long-range precision. Featuring our Splinter camouflage finish and carbon fiber stock with integrated flush cups, the FDX delivers a clean, purpose-driven platform equally at home deep in the backcountry or on the range. The Elevation FDX comes equipped with a TriggerTech trigger, Falkor Defense LW7 action, Hawkins Precision M5 Hunter bottom metal, and a 3-round Hunter magazine for a streamlined and reliable feeding system. Up front, the Salmon River Solutions SRS Combo Rail provides the flexibility to run both ARCA and Picatinny interfaces, giving shooters a stable and adaptable mounting solution for bipods, tripods, and field support equipment. At the heart of the rifle is our Sendero contour carbon fiber barrel featuring PROOF PXT technology - a complete rethinking of conventional rifling geometry and twist progression. By dramatically reducing rifling lead angle and smoothing projectile engagement into the bore, PXT reduces engraving force, minimizes throat erosion, and creates less felt torque during firing for improved recoil control and the ability to stay on target more effectively. The result is a barrel system capable of handling higher pressure ammunition while delivering measurable improvements in consistency and accuracy. In controlled testing, PXT barrels have demonstrated 30–100% increases in barrel life before measurable accuracy degradation, creating a lightweight hunting platform engineered for long-term performance in demanding mountain environments.
